department: School of Civil Engineering and Environmental Science

deadline.value: Applications by January 15, 2027 get funding priority; the final day for international fall recommendations is April 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: FALL APPLICATIONS - 15 February (applications submitted by 15 January)

also.quote: 15 April (final day to submit admission recommendation for international applicants and unsolicited applications)

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional and not needed for admission, though some faculty sponsors may ask for them.
gre_general.quote: Official GRE scores are optional and not required for admission

supervisor.value: Applicants are told to contact CEES faculty directly about research opportunities.
supervisor.quote: Please contact CEES faculty members directly regarding graduate research opportunities

funding.value: Funding is competitive: positions can fill before later applications are reviewed.
funding.quote: Applications received by the initial screening deadline have more opportunities for funding as positions may fill up before later applications are reviewed

entry_route.value: A master's in a related field is typically required for the CEES PhD, though rare exceptions exist.
entry_route.quote: a master’s degree in a related discipline is typically required for admission to all CEES PhD degree programs

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Covers the Civil Engineering and Environmental Engineering PhDs in CEES. The Environmental Science PhD in the same school is not separately recorded.
